tldr: The Sun in Virgo: identity built through skill, discernment, and useful service.
body: With the Sun in Virgo, the core self strengthens through improving what is real, tending the details, and making life work better. You are here to refine without reducing yourself to what still needs fixing.
gift: Precision, humility, analysis, devotion, and practical excellence.
challenge: Perfectionism, criticism, and turning self-improvement into self-harm.
note: Authored from Marie Satori planet-through-sign material.
